name: mental_health
description: Datenpaket für Psychiatrie/Psychologie: PHQ-9, GAD-7, Stress, Schlaf, Mood
description_en: Data package for psychiatry/psychology: PHQ-9, GAD-7, stress, sleep, mood

queries.assessments: SELECT ts, date, instrument, score, details FROM assessments WHERE person = :person AND instrument IN ('PHQ-9','GAD-7','ASRS-5','phq9_score','gad7_score') AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.daily_stress: SELECT date, resting_hr, rmssd_ms, hrv_sdnn_ms, sleep_quality, sleep_hours, training_load, stress_score, source FROM daily_stress WHERE date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.sleep_overview: SELECT date, source_app, total_sleep_min, sleep_score, efficiency_pct, hrv_rmssd_ms, hr_lowest FROM sleep WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.mood_symptoms: SELECT date, symptom, value_num, value_text, category FROM symptoms WHERE person = :person AND (symptom LIKE '%mood%' OR symptom LIKE '%Stimmung%' OR symptom LIKE '%Anxiety%' OR symptom LIKE '%Angst%' OR symptom LIKE '%depress%' OR symptom LIKE '%Konzentration%' OR symptom LIKE '%anxiety%' OR symptom LIKE '%mood_changes%' OR symptom LIKE '%depressed_mood%') AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.mindfulness_sessions: SELECT ts, date, value, source_app FROM measurements WHERE metric='mindful_session' AND person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY ts
queries.medications: SELECT ts, date, drug_name, dose_value, dose_unit FROM medications WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY ts
